notes.title: SugarWinds first Demo
notes.notes:
Hello Pals!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/6OdTs00.jpg[/img]

Today I'm releasing a small Demo of the game.

Is a small experience of how the game mechanics works and the uniqueness of it I have been working on this project on and off since Nov 2014.

Please share your feedback and show your love!

SugarWinds will be ready for release Q1 2021.

Hope you all enjoy it.

I find myself keep playtesting the game longer than usual to get the colony started so I get the feeling is a bit addictive.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KIkTKz0.jpg[/img]

Cheers
Dev
